{{Quote|That was the&hellip;death convulsion we all felt. I almost blacked out.|[[Vestara Khai]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
A '''death convulsion''' was a distinct reaction that a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sentience/Legends|being]] felt as part of a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] when another being [[Death/Legends|died]].

Examples of death convulsions occurred throughout galactic history. One of these examples was how [[Force Adept]]s felt when their masters died. [[Satele Shan]], for instance, experienced a death convulsion upon [[Kao Cen Darach|her master's]] death at the hands of [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] during a [[Battle of Korriban|battle]] over [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Years later, [[Aryn Leneer]] felt it upon the death of her own Master, [[Ven Zallow]], to Malgus during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

Another example of a death convulsion was when many beings died simultaneously. One was created when [[Meetra Surik]] ordered the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] be used to end the [[Mandalorian Wars]] on [[Malachor V]], and it was so powerful it rendered her and [[Darth Nihilus]] living [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wounds in the Force]]. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] felt this while on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was executed. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] also felt a death convulsion when the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], describing it as hearing the entire planet's population screaming, then being cut off suddenly. Students of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] experienced a convulsion when [[Kyp Durron]] [[Destruction of Carida|destroyed]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] with his stolen [[Sun Crusher]].

A third example of a death convulsion was triggered by the death of a particularly powerful Force-sensitive, or when a loved one was lost. [[Zekk]] felt this when [[Brakiss]] died as the [[Shadow Academy]] exploded. During a disastrous [[Mission to Myrkr|mission]] over [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trained at the Jedi Praxeum and members of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] and [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker]] families felt [[Anakin Solo]]'s death at the hands of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The death of [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] at the hands of Anakin's fallen brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] also produced a death convulsion, which was felt by Mara's [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|husband]], [[Ben Skywalker|son]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|sister-in-law]]. Jacen's own death to his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] also could possibly have caused a minor death convulsion, as Jaina and [[Tenel Ka Djo]] felt the Jacen they once knew die, rather than Darth Caedus, the Sith Lord he had become. Almost a century later, the death of [[Darth Krayt]] at the hands of [[Cade Skywalker]] caused his army of [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] to go mad and commit suicide attacks against their fellow Sith.

The [[Tsil]]s of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] produced particularly powerful death convulsions. [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Vestara Khai]] created a convulsion by killing a Tsil to help ensure the survival of her allies.
